mapper.select: SELECT a.account_seq, a.account_id, a.account_passwd, a.account_name, a.account_email, a.main_image_path, a.status, a.account_type, c.cur_name AS curriculum_name, -- 교육과정 테이블과 조인 a.reg_date FROM lms.tb_account a LEFT JOIN lms.tb_curriculum c ON a.cur_seq = c.cur_seq WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT a.account_seq, a.cur_seq, a.account_id, a.account_name, a.birth, a.gender, a.tel, a.edu, a.major, a.status, a.account_email, a.account_type, a.reg_date, c.cur_name, c.room, c.term, c.start_date, c.end_date, a.main_image_path FROM lms.tb_account a LEFT JOIN lms.tb_curriculum c ON a.cur_seq = c.cur_seq WHERE a.cur_seq = #{curSeq} AND a.account_type = 'STU' ORDER BY a.account_name ASC

SELECT -- 1. 학생 기본 및 연락처 정보 a.account_seq, a.account_id, a.account_name, a.birth, a.gender, a.tel, a.emergency_tel, -- 비상 연락처 추가 a.account_email, a.address, a.ident_number, -- 주민등록번호 추가 a.main_image_path, -- 프로필 이미지 경로 추가 a.dropout_date, -- 중도탈락/수강철회 날짜 추가
-- 2. 학력 및 군경력 a.edu, a.major, a.grad_type, a.military_status, a.marital_status, -- 혼인 여부 추가 a.licenses, -- 자격증 추가
-- 3. 이전 경력 및 상태 정보 a.prev_company, -- 전 직장명 추가 a.quit_date, -- 퇴사 일자 추가 a.career, -- 경력 상세 추가 a.status, -- 수강 상태 추가 a.dropout_info, -- 중도 탈락 정보 추가
-- 4. 소속 교육 과정 정보 (Join) c.cur_seq, c.cur_name, c.business_name, -- 사업명 추가 c.start_date, c.end_date, c.room, -- 강의실(호수) 추가 c.term, -- 기수 추가 c.account_seq AS teacher_seq, -- 담당자 ID (select aa.account_name from lms.tb_account aa where aa.account_seq = c.account_seq) AS teacher_name --담임 이름 FROM lms.tb_account a LEFT JOIN lms.tb_curriculum c ON a.cur_seq = c.cur_seq WHERE a.account_seq = #{accountSeq}
SELECT seq, account_seq, file_name FROM lms.tb_account_attachment WHERE account_seq = #{accountSeq} order by seq asc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lms.tb_account ( account_id, account_passwd, account_name, gender, birth, ident_number, tel, emergency_tel, account_email, address, edu, major, grad_type, military_status, marital_status, prev_company, quit_date, licenses, career, main_image_path, status, cur_seq, reg_id ) VALUES ( #{accountId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountPasswd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{birth, jdbcType=DATE}, #{identNumber, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{emergencyTel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountEmail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{edu, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{major, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gradType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{militaryStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{maritalStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prevCompany, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{quitDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{licenses, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{career, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mainImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{curSeq, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{regId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT account_seq, account_id, account_name FROM lms.tb_account WHERE teacher_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY account_name ASC
